patterns.message: Trust Zone (src/lib/audit/**) must remain isolated from AI Zone, API endpoints, React, and UI state.

no-restricted-properties.message: Do not call Date.now() directly in Trust Zone. Clocks must be injected.
Do not call Math.random() directly in Trust Zone. Rules must be deterministic.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Trust Zone must not make network requests.

no-restricted-globals.name: XMLHttpRequest
no-restricted-globals.message: Trust Zone must not make network requests.

no-restricted-globals.name: WebSocket
no-restricted-globals.message: Trust Zone must not open WebSockets.
